item.title: Doers of the Word, Living Out Obedient Faith in a Noisy World
item.description: What does it mean to be a doer of the Word of God? In this Contending for the Word Q&A episode, Dave Jenkins explains how obedient faith flows from union with Christ, is empowered by the Holy Spirit, and is lived out in everyday Christian life (James 1:22–25).

item.title: Job 6, Honest Lament Before a Faithful God
item.description: In Job 6, Job brings honest lament before God. This episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave explores suffering, faithful trust, and biblical lament rooted in Scripture.

item.title: Be Doers of the Word: Living Out James 1:22
item.description: James 1:22 calls Christians to be doers of the Word, not hearers only. In this Anchored in the Word episode, Dave Jenkins explains how Scripture must be applied to daily life for true spiritual growth and obedience.
